name: Jannike
text:
Sanding of the new stage floor is done, so the hall is usable from Monday. Keep the side door locked until the dust settles.
Thanks,
Jannike

name: Schorling
text:
Bin stores are being repainted next week, so the north bins move to the loading yard on Wednesday. Please break down cardboard before you drop anything off, the new compactor jams easily. Normal collection resumes Friday.
Thanks,
Schorling

name: Tegra Donjeta
text:
The all-hands is moving to the auditorium on the second floor because the atrium has the repair scaffolding up all week. Please check in at the desk by ten to nine so we can start on time. Lunch will be sandwiches in the back room afterwards. Bring your own mug if you have one.
Regards,
Tegra Donjeta

name: Natyrë Hatairat
text:
Roof access is open again, so the gutter crew can start Thursday at dawn. Park on the street until their van leaves.
Cheers,
Natyrë Hatairat

name: Anjeli
text:
Quiet hours in the west wing start tonight, so keep calls to the booths after eight. Cleaners vacuum the corridors early, so it should be silent. If you need a room for a late call, book the small studio on four.
Thanks,
Anjeli

name: Taraki
text:
The visitor parking barrier is back online after the lightning strike, and the gate camera is talking to the office again. Badge in as usual at the vehicle gate, but expect a short queue Monday while the guards relearn the new panel. Report any double charges to reception and we will refund them the same day.
Thanks,
Taraki

name: Thayron Pollonini
text:
Canteen menu is back to the winter rota, so the soup kettle runs again from Monday. Vegan options are on the board by the till.
Best,
Thayron Pollonini

name: van Doorne
text:
Photocopier contract renewed, so the old code stops working Friday at noon. Collect your print jobs before then or they queue until the new machine lands on Monday. IT will clear the backlog at the weekend.
Regards,
van Doorne

name: Idalia
text:
Frost warning for the next three nights, so bring the geraniums into the porch and wrap the outdoor tap. The caretaker has salt for the paths and will grit the ramp before six each morning. If your lock freezes, warm the key rather than forcing it. Keep the dogs off the deck until it thaws.
Cheers,
Idalia

name: Modrusan
text:
Lift two is out until the engineer signs it off, so use the north stairs for the rest of the day.
Thanks,
Modrusan

name: Della Bruna
text:
The staff survey closes Friday, and we are still short of responses from the night teams. It takes six minutes and answers stay anonymous. Paper copies sit by the time clock.
Thanks,
Della Bruna

name: Alana Reber
text:
Half-term cover is sorted, so the pool reaches full staffing again from Monday. The rota on the noticeboard reflects the new shift pattern, with two lifeguards on every public session. If you swapped a slot with someone, tell the desk today so we can update the sheet before payroll locks it.
Thanks,
Alana Reber

name: Azalea
text:
Reminder that your chiropody visit is Wednesday at 11:30 at the foot clinic. Bring the insoles fitted for you last time.
Thanks,
Azalea

name: Semenova
text:
Your sleep clinic follow-up is Monday at 2:40 at the Beacon practice, room 12. Bring the diary sheets from the last month and the mask you were issued. The nurse asked that you log any caffeine after noon.
Thanks,
Semenova

name: Nakia Nelinda Marteen
text:
Your genetic counseling appointment is on Tuesday, November 4, at 1:30 p.m. with Marta in the Rosewood medical building, suite 310. Plan for ninety minutes, since the session includes a family history review. Bring any previous test results and a list of questions you want to cover. Parking is validated on level two.
Regards,
Nakia Nelinda Marteen

name: Leonita Boufidis
text:
Your dental hygiene visit is Thursday at 8:20 at the Elm practice. The hygienist asked you to arrive with clean retainers.
Thanks,
Leonita Boufidis

name: Jean-Albert
text:
Your pacemaker check is Wednesday at 10:40 at the cardiac clinic, ground floor. Skip coffee and take your usual pills with water. The technician will download the device and post a summary to your GP. Expect the letter within a week.
Thanks,
Jean-Albert

name: Rocak
text:
Your audiology fitting is on Friday at 9:15 at the HearWell center on Trafalgar Road. The appointment covers the hearing aid trial and a short tutorial on cleaning and batteries. Bring the devices you trialed last time even if you did not like them, since the audiologist logs the feedback.
Thanks,
Rocak

name: Digironimo Di Gironimo
text:
Your vision screening is Tuesday at 3:10 at the school health room. Bring your current glasses, even for reading.
Best,
Digironimo Di Gironimo

name: Shaumiya Vusala
text:
Your colposcopy follow-up is Monday at 8:45 at the women's health unit on the fourth floor. Allow two hours, since the clinic runs behind in the mornings. Bring the letter from your last visit and a list of current medicines.
Thanks,
Shaumiya Vusala

name: Aglaja
text:
Your knee MRI is booked for Thursday, November 13, at 7:20 in the evening at the north imaging center. Eat nothing after four and drink only water until you check in. The referral is already on file, so bring photo ID and your insurance card. The radiographer will ring the day before to confirm the time.
Sincerely,
Aglaja

name: Presset
text:
Your flu jab is walk-in on Saturday morning between nine and twelve at the pharmacy on the high street.
Thanks,
Presset

name: Togan Aluis
text:
Your driving assessment is Tuesday at 10:00 at the mobility center on Dean Street. The car sent has hand controls, and the instructor will spend twenty minutes fitting them to you before the route. Bring your license and any specialist letters.
Regards,
Togan Aluis

name: Megjide Rittig
text:
Your gastroscopy is scheduled for Monday, November 10, at 11:15 at the Saint Aldric endoscopy suite on the second floor. Do not eat after midnight and stop all clear fluids at seven in the morning. A friend must collect you, since the sedation takes most of the afternoon to wear off.
Best regards,
Megjide Rittig

name: Stavri
text: Stavri: the vending machine on three takes cards again, so no more coin runs. The tech replaced the reader this morning.

name: Tesfagiorgis
text: Tesfagiorgis: the garden waste bins finally arrived, so the green collections start next Tuesday. Leave them by the curb the night before, handles facing the road. The old blue sacks are no longer accepted.

name: Marieluisa Chidera
text: Marieluisa Chidera: the telescopes are back from servicing, and the mirrors are aligned as well as they have ever been. Club night is Friday at 8, and we will try the Ring Nebula first while it is high in the east. Bring a red torch, since white light ruins dark adaptation.

name: Musan Liambo
text: Musan Liambo: paddle club is moving to the lake side gates, since the boathouse ramp is still under repair this month.

name: Cham
text: Cham: the food co-op order closes Wednesday at noon, so add your items to the sheet tonight. Pickup is Friday between four and six at the community hall. Bring your own bags and small change, since the card reader is still glitchy.

name: Beçiri
text: Beçiri: the kiln firing scheduled for Thursday slipped to Saturday because the controller needs a new thermocouple. Leave your greenware on the shelf with a note of the glaze you used, and Dana will load the first batch at ten. Bisque pieces from last month are cooled and ready for collection.

name: Keyshia Naíma Örten
text: Keyshia Naíma Örten: badge photos are being retaken Friday morning in the lobby, since the new system rejects the old ones.

name: Ben Arbia
text: Ben Arbia: the seedling swap is on Saturday at the allotment shed, so label anything you bring. Tables are up from nine, and tea is free for anyone who helps with setup. Last year the tomato starts went in minutes.

name: Natthaphon
text: Natthaphon: the repair cafe moved to the first Saturday of the month, since the library now hosts the reading group on our old date. Bring broken small appliances and we will teach you to fix them at the long tables. Tools are provided, but spare parts cost a small donation.

name: Johnson
text: Johnson: the coop lock finally turns smoothly, so the sticky latch story is closed. Spare keys hang in the shed.

name: Waldburga Zafu
text: Waldburga Zafu: the climbing roses need tying in before the wind picks up, so bring gloves and the soft twine from the potting bench. The older canes by the fence are due for a hard prune, but leave that to the head gardener.

name: Bougaoua Ostrozubi
text: Bougaoua Ostrozubi: the observatory trip is confirmed for the 21st, and the coach leaves the science block at half four in the afternoon. We stop for food on the way back, so bring cash or a packed dinner. Dress warm, the dome is not heated and the temperature drops fast after dark. Permission slips are due Friday.

name: Lelouch-Ferdinand
text: Lelouch-Ferdinand: the darkroom timer is fixed, so we can run the full printing session Thursday without the phone countdown. Bring your negatives.

name: Rehab
text: Rehab, your dental cleaning with Dr. Okafor is on Thursday at 9:00 a.m. at the Riverside clinic. Reply YES to confirm or call the front desk to move it. Please arrive ten minutes early to update your records.

name: Dropmann
text: Dropmann, your physical therapy session is on Monday at 4:15 p.m. at the Summit rehab center, room 2B. Parking is validated at the garage on Ellis Street. Please arrive ten minutes early to check in at the front desk. Wear comfortable clothes and bring the resistance band provided.

name: van der Bent
text: van der Bent, your eye exam is on Friday at 11:45 with Dr. Whitfield at the Parkview optometry office. Bring your current glasses.

name: Nurian Gautschi
text: Nurian Gautschi, this is a reminder for your vet appointment for Biscuit on Saturday at 10:30 a.m. at the Cedar Grove animal hospital. Please bring the vaccination record from last year.

name: Ruairí
text: Ruairí, your registration renewal window opens on Monday, November 3, and closes on Friday, November 14. Bring your current license and proof of address to any branch office. Renewals are not accepted over the phone. Masks are recommended while you wait. Free parking is available behind the building.

name: Jupin
text: Jupin, your haircut appointment with Marco is on Wednesday at 6:30 p.m. at the Fade Room on Grand Avenue. Please arrive with dry hair.

name: Cid Puenkhang Netala
text: Cid Puenkhang Netala, your seat is confirmed for the wine tasting on Saturday at 7:00 p.m. at the Old Press cellar. The event runs about two hours, and spitting buckets are provided.

name: van Harxen
text: van Harxen, the HOA roof inspection is scheduled for Thursday, November 6, between 9:00 a.m. and noon. Access to the attic hatch is required, so leave the hallway closet unlocked. The crew starts at the north end. Any cracked tiles will be photographed and logged before repairs begin.

name: Erfan
text: Erfan, your therapy intake call is Tuesday at 2:00 p.m. with Dana, one of the evening clinicians. Keep your insurance card handy.

name: Pandiani
text: Pandiani, the mold inspection crew arrives Thursday between 1 and 3 p.m., so clear the cabinets under both bathroom sinks tonight. Expect them to run fans for a day afterwards. They will also seal the crawlspace vents.

name: Ivica Afis Zucale
text: Ivica Afis Zucale, the tour van picks up from the north gate at 6:15 a.m., so be in the lobby by 6:00. Bring a jacket and cash for the tram tickets. The guide collects the group fee on the bus, exact change preferred if you can. Luggage goes under the seats.

name: Loredano Napoletano
text: Loredano Napoletano, your shift at the polling station starts Thursday at 6 a.m. with a briefing at the town annex. Bring photo ID and your training packet.

name: Sardano
text: Sardano, your flight lesson is booked Sunday at 8:15 a.m. at the county airfield. Bring your logbook, headset, and the weather report from the night before. The briefing starts twenty minutes prior.
